title: M0 Evidence Summary
description: Machine-readable record of one quality-gate execution: which checks ran, what they exited with, which artifacts they produced, and which acceptance criteria that mechanically supports. This schema deliberately lives under evidence/ rather than contracts/: it governs an internal evidence document, not an inter-repository interface, so it is not a published contract and is not catalogued. Its $id is a URL rather than a contracts URN for the same reason - a URN in the contracts namespace would assert membership in a namespace this document does not belong to.

working_tree_clean.description: Whether every tracked build input matched the commit when the gate ran. evidence/ is excluded because it is an output of the gate rather than an input to a build. A false value means the recorded commit_sha does not describe what was actually built, so no result in this document is release-valid.

skipped.description: Checks not executed in this run. A non-empty list is a reduced run, and every criterion depending on a skipped check is reported not_run rather than assumed.

artifacts.description: Release artifacts present when the summary was written, with their real digests.

status.description: pass means every check in derived_from executed and exited 0 - nothing more. It is not a judgement that the criterion is satisfied in spirit; it is the mechanical consequence of the checks named here.

derived_from.description: Gate checks whose exit codes determine this status. Empty means no executed check evidences this criterion, which forces not_run.

milestone_verdict.description: pass only when every criterion is pass. ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.md treats not_run as fail for milestone completion, so any not_run yields not_complete.
